description.value: Tony's Fish & Oyster Café has been a fixture at the entrance of Granville Island since 2002, earning recognition as one of Vancouver's Top 20 Seafood Restaurants and multiple TripAdvisor Certificates of Excellence. The restaurant specializes in battered fish and chips made with wild sockeye salmon, Pacific cod, and Atlantic haddock, alongside house-made clam chowder and a signature banana flambé. It's a walk-in, first-come-first-served spot well-positioned on the cycling routes that converge at Granville Island.
